name: uni-verein
description: Free, open-source club management for university associations. Uni-verein is a web-based app, usable on desktop and mobile, that helps you track members, dues, documents, and event emails in one place, so your team spends less time on admin and more on what matters.

paragraphs: Live Demo · Documentation · Report a Bug · Request a Feature

Uni-verein is a free and open source club management software specifically designed for university associations and student clubs. Whether you run a sports club, a cultural association, or any other student organization — uni-verein helps you manage your members, mails and finances all in one place.
features: 👥 Member Management — Add, edit, and organize members
💰 Finance Tracking — Keep track of membership fees, income, and expenses
📄 Document Storage — Store and share important club documents and files
📧 Email Notifications — Send mails for events or announcements
📅 Calendar — Plan events together, invite members, recurring events, reminders, webcal subscriptions and a public club calendar
